newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer on poor dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer on poor dollar demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed slightly firmer at 43.2950/3000 to the dollar in interbank trading against the previous 43.2970/3000 close, dealers said.
Dealers said the taka remained steady after opening at 43.2950/2990. "The market was mostly depressed with little demand for dollars from importers," said one dealer with a foreign bank.
Interbank call money rates closed at 6.0 percent to 6.5 percent against Monday's 6.0-7.0 percent.
